answer_1.quote: Controllable Text Simplification can be framed as a conditional language modeling task, where the source text X is rewritten as an output Y ...
answer_1.outputs: Simplified text generated at a target reading grade level

answer_2.quote: We measure the complexity of the outputs generated and compare them with the complexity of the Newsela references by computing the Automatic Readability Index (ARI)... we also report SARI, BLEU, BERTScore, and Flesch Reading Ease scores.
